Game Overview

In Square Run, the core idea is straightforward: navigate through a perilous journey in this challenging square-running game. Jump and double jump to evade deadly obstacles, mastering precise timing to survive the relentless onslaught. Test your reflexes and endurance in an addictive quest for high scores. Can you conquer the endless run?
